hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE 'knowledge/.*\.md$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Knowledge document updated. Remember to check frontmatter (title, tags, created, updated) is present and correct."}}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreCompact","additionalContext":"This is a knowledge base project (KUKARO-SEARCH). Preserve: current topic being worked on, any pending document updates, and the knowledge directory structure context."}}'
